challenge_outcome.conclusion: A real browser is required, the session cookie (cf_clearance) is necessary but not sufficient outside that browser, and the budget is small: one successful page load flips the origin into a cooldown that outlasted every later attempt. Future runs are cheap only if they reuse the persistent profile and touch the origin ONCE — the HTTP 200 page body already contains all five /oyy-api payloads.
